name: Vine The
overview: Scripture presents the vine as a significant symbol of growth, fruitfulness, and divine provision, beginning with Noah's planting of a vineyard (Genesis 9:20) and the depiction of a vine with three fruitful branches producing ripe grapes (Genesis 40:10). The vine also illustrates the blessing and abundance associated with God's people, as seen in the imagery of binding a foal to the vine and washing garments in wine (Genesis 49:11). Additionally, the careful tending of the vine through pruning and gathering fruit (Leviticus 25:3) reflects God's ongoing work in cultivating His people. The Nazirite's separation from all products of the vine (Numbers 6:3-4) further underscores the vine's spiritual significance and the call to holiness.
